author: felicepantaleo
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds `TracksterLinkingbyCornetto`, a trackster linking plugin registered as `Cornetto` in `TracksterLinkingPluginFactory`. A job selects it with `linkingPSet = cms.PSet(type = cms.string("Cornetto"))` in `TracksterLinksProducer`. With the `ticl_v6` process modifier (#52579), `ticlTracksterLinks` uses `Cornetto` with the defaults of its parameter description, on the CLUE3DHigh and Recovery tracksters. This applies to the offline reconstruction only; the HLT does not change. The default reconstruction does not change. Only the workflows with `ticl_v6` change, for example 29634.207 and 29634.532. The tuned parameters of TICLv6 come in a later PR.

Code layout: the pair test, the parent search and the emission rule are in `interface/CornettoLinking.h` and `src/CornettoLinking.cc`, the cone geometry in `interface/CornettoGeometry.h`, the grouping in `interface/CornettoGrouping.h`, and the trackster features in `interface/CornettoFeatures.h`. All are in the `RecoTICL/Linking` library, so the unit tests call them directly. `RecoTICL/Configuration/python/catalog.py` lists `Cornetto` in the pyTICL linking types, for completeness.


#### PR validation:

On CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-17-2300 (master e2fed1b5919), el8_amd64_gcc14:
- `scram b` after `scram b clean`, `scram b code-format` (no change), `scram b code-checks` (findings only in external Eigen headers) and `scram b check-headers`: clean. `edmPluginDump` lists `Cornetto` in `TracksterLinkingPluginFactory`, and `edmPluginHelp -p TracksterLinksProducer` shows its parameter description.
- Unit tests, all pass:
  - `testCornettoLinking` (226 assertions): the tile parent search against an O(N^2) brute-force search, 60 trials per section with 30 to 325 random clustered tracksters, both endcaps, |eta| from 1.0 to 3.8, a third of the seeds on the phi seam, equal energies, and tracksters with a non-finite position or energy. The tile result equals the brute force in every trial. The test fails when the eta clamp of the search is removed, and when `etaWindow` is above the allowed maximum. It also tests the pair test (EM cone, type veto, time gate, endcaps, eta window) and the emission rule at its threshold edges.
  - `testCornettoConfiguration` (25 assertions): `TracksterLinksProducer` with `type = "Cornetto"` builds with the default and with valid values, and throws for 18 invalid values.
  - `testCornettoGeometry`, `testCornettoGrouping`, `testCornettoFeatures`.
  - The 10 pyTICL tests of `RecoTICL/Configuration`.
- Configuration, on CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-24-2300 (contains #52579): the step 2 and step 3 configurations of 29634.0 and 29634.531 give the same `process.dumpPython()` output with and without the `ticl_v6` commit of this PR. The step 2 configurations of 29634.207 and 29634.0 give the same `process.dumpPython()` output, and so do those of 29634.532 and 29634.531. In step 3, the only difference is the `linkingPSet` of `ticlTracksterLinks`.
- 29634.207 and 29634.532, 3 events each: all 5 steps of 29634.207 and all 4 steps of 29634.532 pass. The provenance of step 3 shows `ticlTracksterLinks` with `type = 'Cornetto'`.

Presentation foreseen at next reco meeting.
title: RecoTICL/Linking: the Cornetto trackster linking plugin
